about: Hand-kept half of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: which module computes each plans.json section, each served source id and each core number. scripts/architecture-map.mjs checks every entry against the code (the schema's own lists, the file, the symbol) and test/architecture-map.test.js fails CI when one no longer holds. Edit this file, then run `npm run map:architecture`.

producers.owns: plans.json, the War Room file: one entry per league, rewritten by the refresh loop. Nothing on the request path computes a plan.
one league's plan: candidate paths, the confirmed best move, the deck, risk modes, catch-up, partners.
title odds and playoff odds (the season Monte Carlo).
a trade's title-odds change, on paired seeds.
the weekly points range for a lineup (locks and settled points included).
the acceptance band a P(yes) is the midpoint of.
the served P(yes) for an offer, whichever model is switched on.
the 0-100 blue-chip score and its label (Blue chip is 83+).
no number: the pass or refuse verdict for Nick's rules on any give/get. Every served trade passes it.
the number-health rows (ok / warn / broken per check).
no number: reads plans.json and serves it to the War Room. A reader, never a second producer.

attention.what: which league needs Nick first, ranked across leagues.

destination.what: where the best plan ends: the roster and its title odds.

feasibility.what: can the goal be reached, by when, at what cost.

feasibility_points.what: the points question on a league planned on something else.

finder_best_expected.what: the Trade Lab finder's best single offer, beside the plan's.

next_move.what: the one move to make now, after the confirm dice.

alternatives.what: the rest of the deck (at most five).

itinerary.what: the plan's stops plus Nick's own stops and untouchables.

stop_tradeoffs.what: what adding or removing a stop costs.

targets.what: players worth going after, with the best path to each.

catch_up.what: free, flip, desperate, swing and timing moves, in order.

speed_curve.what: cost of arriving by week N.

number_health.what: which served numbers are ok, warn or broken.

risk_modes.what: safe / balanced / all-in best plans on the same dice, beside doing nothing.

partners.what: who to deal with: P(responds) and the best edge through that team.

teams.what: who each roster is, read at run time and never committed.

ladders.what: depth to level-below to blue-chip chains (shadow).

p_yes_basis.what: which P(yes) model the steps serve, with each model's record.

sim.title.what: title odds and their change from the season sim.

clone.accept.what: P(yes) from the acceptance band (the default with no P(yes) flag on).

clone.price.what: opening offer and walk-away price, on the partner's screen.

plan.path.what: anything read off the chosen plan (moves, deck, itinerary).

coach.text.what: model-written text: reasoning panels and offer messages.

plan.template.what: text built by a template from engine facts only.

chat.labels.what: chat-DB labels and counts, never chat text.

asset.ros.what: a player's rest-of-season points a game (waiver claims).

fp.ros.what: FantasyPros rest-of-season rank. Internal comparison only: never displayed (Nick's rule).

blend.accept.what: P(yes) from the graded blend of baseline and clone (GRIDIRON_PYES_BLEND).

usage.xfp.what: usage up, points down (xFP) for buy-low reads.
